about_the_game:
In a parallel(or is it?) timeline, Scrap Girl decides to go camping one day. Sure enough she gets caught up in a series of odd adventures. A mysterious cloaked figure has tasked you to find several colorful eggs scattered across the land. What could be the point of such a task? Join Scrap Girl to find out in this standalone adventure.

- Core Mechanics

  • Exploration

    • Explore a semi-vast, semi-open world environment finding secrets and rewards. Interact with the many objects along the way to see what they do.

    • Light platforming adventure to keep you on your toes while adventuring.

    • Chat with the local villagers, and even help them out with some errands.

  • Turn-based Quick Time Event Combat

    • Increase your battle power with successful "Chance Time Commands" to deal out extra damage and bonuses to enemies.

    • Take action when defending too! Reduce incoming damage with well timed guard commands, or activate special shield abilities.

    • Get scrappy with it and customize your battle style with adornments aptly named "Deco" to suite your playstyle.

    • Create custom attack combos with the "Stamp" system to stack and apply attributes to your attacks. Got a flying enemy with a lot of defense? No problem, just stamp one of your abilities to throw and pierce!

    • Join the team! Sometimes others may join you on your adventure. You never know, maybe even the critters you scrap with might be so impressed by your fighting prowess, they will give you their card to summon them into battle.

  • For a longer list of features, see the base game store page.

- About the Demo

This demo is a standalone adventure from the main game. While it does reuse assets, the level layouts, scenario, and dialogue is all unique to this standalone demo. As such, progress from this demo will not be transferable to the main game. There may however be a bonus for completing the demo that will transfer.
